sig: [[["A", "Hi, Liam. Bad news: the Tokyo client just moved our meeting from Thursday to Friday afternoon."], ["B", "Oh, great. Our return flight's on Friday at six p.m."], ["A", "Exactly. The meeting runs from two to five, so there's no way we'll make it to the airport."], ["B", "Right. Let me check the airline's site. There's one at ten on Saturday morning, or one at eleven-forty Friday night."], ["A", "And when does the late one get in?"], ["B", "Seven on Saturday morning. Either way, the change fee is a hundred and twenty dollars each."], ["A", "I'd rather skip the red-eye. Could we stay one more night at the hotel?"], ["B", "I'll check. Our hotel has rooms at a hundred and fifty a night."], ["A", "That's fine. Can you rebook the flights, and I'll extend the hotel?"], ["B", "Sure. I'll also give Finance a heads-up about the extra cost."]], {"A": "F-US", "B": "M-AU"}]
